newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA ADCORP CAUTIONS ON SHARES.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA ADCORP CAUTIONS ON SHARES.

text.p: South African services group Adcorp Holdings said on Friday it was currently in talks which, if successful, could impact its share price.
The firm warned shareholders to exercise caution in their dealings in its shares until a further announcement is made and gave no futher details in a brief statement.
In July the firm bought personnel placement firm Grey Appointments in a deal to be settled by a half-half mixture of cash and Adcorp shares, but did not give details.
Adcorp did not give the purchase price of Grey, a staff recruitment company specialising in placement of senior financial staff.
